summary.name: Google Flow Music
summary.one_liner: Google Flow Music is a generative AI music platform for creating, remixing, and sharing full-length songs, with AI music video creation and a space for building custom music tools.
use_cases: build custom audio plugins or instruments
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a studio-style interface where users chat with a "Producer" to create full-length songs with vocals, using the Lyria 3.5 music model. It offers an AI music video feature that uses the Veo video model, where users control characters and aesthetics. A vibe-coding option lets users build things like audio plugins, music games, and custom DAWs. Users can create playlists, publish songs, follow artists, and the platform says it learns the user's style over time. Unlimited downloads are mentioned.
notable: Chat with a Producer to create full-length songs using the Lyria 3.5 model
Vibe-code custom audio plugins, music games, and DAWs
Learns personal style the more you create
caveats: Page says 'Free to start' with no credit card required, but does not detail paid tiers or limits
Page lists Riffusion only as an awesome-ai-tools listing; the URL redirects to Google Flow Music, so the Riffusion name is no longer shown on the page
